EF1
Meet Excel: workbook, worksheet
and grid
Watch first
1. Chandoo - Excel screen and navigation
Assigned range: 01:15-04:09. Stop manually at the end. Excel screen and navigation. Chapter-based assignment;
complete playback has not been checked in this review.
Pause to connect the demonstration to the example below. Use the printed stop time when a bounded range is
given; longer recordings remain available for reference.
What you will do
Open the supplied workbook, enter two values at exact addresses, then create and reopen a
small workbook of your own. You need only M00 file-and-folder skills. Allow about 60-90 minutes
including the video and your own attempt. Extra time is normal on your first day with Excel.
Words before we use them
Word
Meaning and example
Workbook
The whole Excel file, such as M01_Practice.xlsx.
Worksheet
One tab inside that file. P-EF1_Navigation is one worksheet.
Cell
One box where a value or formula can be stored.
Address
Column letter followed by row number. C5 means column C, row 5.
Active cell
The selected cell. Typing replaces its content unless you enter edit mode.
Name Box
The box beside the Formula Bar that shows the selected address.
Formula Bar
The area above the grid showing the selected cell's value or formula.
Picture it in your head
A workbook is like a notebook. Its worksheets are pages, and every box on a page has an
address. Summary!E9 means: open the Summary worksheet, then find column E and row 9. E9
on Sales is a different cell.
Follow with me once
1. In the module's Practice folder, make a copy of M01_Practice.xlsx called
M01_My_Attempt.xlsx. Open the copy on your PC. Use your phone for the book or video while
your PC is the practice surface.

2. Select the P-EF1_Navigation tab at the bottom. Switch to P-EF2_Structure and back so you can
see that the file stays open while the page changes.
3. Click the Name Box, type C5 and press Enter. Confirm C5 appears in the Name Box. Type
North and press Enter. Excel may now select C6. Click C5 again to inspect the value you just
entered.
4. Jump to D7 in the same way. Type Check. Select D7 and look at the Formula Bar: it should
show Check.
5. Press Ctrl+S. Close the workbook, reopen your saved copy and inspect C5 and D7 again.
What you should see, and why
On P-EF1_Navigation, C5 contains North and D7 contains Check after reopening. The selected
address tells Excel where to put your entry; saving writes the changed workbook to a file. Moving
the selection after Enter does not move the value you entered.
If you get stuck
If a value appears in the wrong box, press Ctrl+Z immediately and select the correct address
before retyping. If you cannot find the sheet, use the sheet navigation arrows at the bottom. If
you see a read-only warning, save your own writable copy. If you accidentally type over an
instruction, undo it or return to the untouched starter.
Try it yourself
Create a new blank workbook called EF1_My_Workbook.xlsx. Rename its first three sheets Sales,
Customers and Summary. On Summary, use the Name Box to select E9 and type Ready. Save,
close and reopen. Do this without following the five guided steps above.
Check your work
Verify the filename, three sheet names and Summary!E9. Click Sales!E9 too: it should be empty.
Explain aloud: "Workbook is the file; worksheet is the tab; E9 is an address within a worksheet."
Save the file itself as evidence. A screenshot alone cannot prove it reopens correctly.
Review and changed retry
After saving, open EF1 in Protected Worked Answers. Then close it and make a fresh workbook
with a sheet called Stock, entering Checked in B12. You are ready for EF2 when you can choose
the sheet, address and saved file without guessing.

EF2
Enter, edit, save and structure data
Watch first
1. Chandoo - Entering a simple sales tracker
Assigned range: 04:09-07:35. Stop manually at the end. Entering a simple sales tracker. Chapter-based assignment;
complete playback has not been checked in this review.
Pause to connect the demonstration to the example below. Use the printed stop time when a bounded range is
given; longer recordings remain available for reference.
What you will do
Use one row for one employee, edit the correct employee's city, then build a five-record receipt
list. The supplied worksheet contains employee data. Keep the employee example and the
receipt task separate. Allow 75-105 minutes.
Words before we use them
Word
Plain meaning
Record
A complete row describing one thing. Here that thing is one employee.
Field
One kind of information, such as City or Monthly Pay.
Header
The name at the top of a column.
Grain
Exactly what one row represents.
Raw data
The starting records before you add summaries or calculations.
Why the rectangle matters
Excel can sort and filter reliably when records occupy one continuous rectangle with one header
row. A decorative blank row can split that rectangle. A total mixed into employee rows describes
a different kind of thing. Keep titles, notes and totals outside the raw records.
Follow with me once
1. Open P-EF2_Structure in your saved working copy. The supplied employee block is A8:F13.
Row 8 contains headers; rows 9-13 contain five employees.
2. Read the header sequence: Employee ID, Name, City, Department, Start Date, Monthly Pay.
Point to E003 in A11 before editing anything.
3. Click C11, confirm the row still shows E003 and Neha, and replace Dumka with Deoghar. Do
not sort or move any other value.
4. In an empty area below your work, write: "One row represents one employee in this supplied
staff list." Save and reopen. Recheck E003's city and confirm all five employee IDs still exist.

E003 belongs to Neha and now has City = Deoghar. E001, E002, E004 and E005 keep their
previous values. Looking up the employee ID before editing prevents changing somebody else

the employee.

Check your work
There must be five data rows, six fields and one header row. No empty decorative row, merged

If you get stuck and changed retry
If everything pastes into one cell, undo and enter the six fields separately using Tab to move

receipt records should still form a single rectangle.

EF3
Data types, number formats and
clean layout
Watch first
1. GCFLearnFree - Understanding Number Formats
Optional visual - no verified bounded range. Relevant demonstration: number formats, percentages and dates. Use
the worked lesson immediately afterward.
Pause to connect the demonstration to the example below. Use the printed stop time when a bounded range is
given; longer recordings remain available for reference.
What you will do
Distinguish what Excel stores from how it displays that value. Preserve identifiers such as 00101,
display numeric fractions as percentages, and use dates that Excel can order correctly. Allow
90-120 minutes.
Words before we use them
Word
Meaning
Number
A value you can use in arithmetic, such as 1250 or 0.10.
Text
A label or identifier. Member ID 00101 is text even though it uses digits.
Number format
A display rule applied to a stored number.
Percentage
A fraction displayed per hundred. 0.10 is 10%.
Date value
A number Excel interprets as a calendar date. A date-looking string may still
be text.
Follow with me once
1. Open P-EF3_Formatting. Select C9:C13. On Home, choose Currency or Number with two
decimal places. C9 represents 1250 before and after this display change.
2. Select D9:D13 and choose Percentage with one decimal place. D9 should show 10.0%; D10
should show 7.5%. These were already numeric fractions. Do not multiply the values by 100 as
well.
3. Select B9:B13 and choose a readable Date format. The supplied dates run from 10 August to
14 August 2026.
4. Inspect E9:E13. These member identifiers are already text and must remain 00101 through
00105. Before entering a new ID, format the destination as Text. Changing 101 to Text after the
zeros were lost does not recover the original ID.
FOUR-COURSE SYSTEM  /  2026

Astra-parity study edition 2.0  |  Video, explanation, practice, proof
Contents
5. In an unused cell, enter =D9*1000. The result is 100: ten percent of 1000. This arithmetic
check tests the value rather than relying on its appearance.
What you should see, and why
1250 displayed as currency is still the same amount. 0.10 displayed as 10.0% is still the same
fraction. A member ID is a name for a member, so adding or averaging IDs has no useful
meaning. A cell's alignment is a clue about its type, but it is not a reliable type test by itself.
Try it yourself
Create headers in A20:E20: Member ID, Start Date, Monthly Fee, Renewal Rate, Active?. Enter
the following rows in A21:E25. Set column A's destination cells to Text before entering the
identifiers. Enter the rates as numeric fractions, then apply Percentage. Active? is a Yes/No label
in this exercise.
Member ID
Start Date
Monthly Fee
Renewal Rate
Active?
Yes
Yes
No
Yes
Yes
For an unambiguous date entry, type =DATE(2026,8,1) for the first date, changing the final
number for the others. DATE is a function that builds a date from year, month and day. Some
local Excel installations use semicolons between arguments; use the separator Excel requests.
Display the dates clearly. The zero fee is an intentional value, not a missing value.
Check your work and recover
Your first renewal rate should display as 80.0%, and its multiplication by 100 should equal 80. If
it shows 8000%, inspect the stored fraction. If a number appears as ####, widen the column
before changing the value. If 00021 becomes 21, undo and re-enter the original ID into a
Text-formatted cell. Do not manufacture zeros for an unknown ID.
Review and changed retry
Save your attempt before opening EF3's answer. For a changed retry, add member 00026 with
fee 650 and renewal rate 0.65. Explain which values support arithmetic and which are identifiers.
Chronological sorting is practised safely in EF4.

EF4
Sort and filter safely
Watch first
1. Leila Gharani - How to SORT Data in Excel | 7 Tips
Optional visual - no verified bounded range. Focus on safe whole-record sorting. The book supplies the matching
filter task.
Pause to connect the demonstration to the example below. Use the printed stop time when a bounded range is
given; longer recordings remain available for reference.
What you will do
Answer "Which Cash order has the highest amount?" without separating an order from its
customer. Then solve the same kind of question for service tickets. Allow 75-105 minutes.
Words before we use them
Word
Meaning
Sort
Change the order of whole records.
Ascending
Small to large, or A to Z.
Descending
Large to small, or Z to A.
Filter
Temporarily show only records meeting a condition.
Row integrity
The fields belonging to one record stay together.
Follow with me once
1. On P-EF4_SortFilter, inspect A8:F18. There are ten orders, O101-O110. Save your copy before
sorting.
2. Select the whole range A8:F18 and choose Data > Filter. Open the Payment Method header
arrow, clear Select All, and select Cash.
3. Open the Amount header arrow and choose largest to smallest. If Excel asks whether to
expand a sort selection, include the whole data rectangle. Stop if you are unsure which fields will
move together.
4. Read the first visible record across, not just its amount. It should identify O103, Charu, North,
Monitor, Cash, 18500.
5. Clear the Payment Method filter. Ten records should be visible again. They can remain sorted;
clearing a filter does not restore the original order.
FOUR-COURSE SYSTEM  /  2026

Astra-parity study edition 2.0  |  Video, explanation, practice, proof

What you should see, and why
The visible Cash IDs in descending amount order are O103, O108, O109, O105, O101. Filtering
hid other rows; it did not delete them. Sorting Amount alone would detach amounts from their
orders, making a plausible-looking list wrong.
Try it yourself
Enter headers Ticket ID, Priority, Open Days, Owner in A25:D25 and these eight records in rows
26-33. Filter High, sort Open Days descending, identify the oldest High ticket and clear the filter.

Check your work and recover
The owner must remain attached to the same Ticket ID after sorting. Count all eight IDs again
after clearing the filter. A count alone would not catch a one-column sort, so also compare at
least two complete records with the input above. If a row relationship breaks, undo immediately
or return to your saved copy. Do not try to repair the row associations from memory.
Review and changed retry
After saving, compare your result with EF4's worked answer. For the retry, change T05's Open
Days to 11, reapply the filter and sort, and identify the new oldest High ticket. This checks that
you can rerun the method when the data changes.

EF5
Formula basics and arithmetic
Watch first
1. Chandoo - Formula demonstration
Assigned range: 15:46-21:01. Stop manually at the end. Formula demonstration. Chapter-based assignment;
complete playback has not been checked in this review.
Pause to connect the demonstration to the example below. Use the printed stop time when a bounded range is
given; longer recordings remain available for reference.
What you will do
Build formulas that recalculate when inputs change. Revenue means Quantity multiplied by Unit
Price. Cost in this worksheet means the total cost for the whole row, not the cost of one unit.
Profit is Revenue minus that total Cost. Margin is Profit divided by Revenue. Allow 90-120
minutes.
Words before we use them
Word
Meaning
Formula
An instruction starting with =, such as =B9*C9.
Reference
The address of a cell whose current value a formula uses.
Operator
An arithmetic symbol: +, -, * for multiply, / for divide.
Dependent cell
A formula cell that uses another cell's value.
Fill down
Copy a formula to lower rows, allowing relative references to move.
Follow with me once
1. Open P-EF5_Formulas. The upper demonstration already contains formulas. Select E9 and read
=B9*C9 in the Formula Bar. B9 is 4 and C9 is 250, so Revenue is 1000.
2. Select F9: =E9-D9 subtracts the row's total cost of 700, giving Profit 300. Select G9: =F9/E9
gives 0.30, displayed as 30%.
3. In your working copy, change C9 from 250 to 300. Revenue becomes 1200, Profit 500 and
Margin about 41.67%. Cost is held fixed for this sensitivity check.
4. Restore C9 to 250 and confirm the original values return. A typed constant of 1000 would not
have responded to the change.
FOUR-COURSE SYSTEM  /  2026
C1 / M01  /  LEARNER BOOK
Astra-parity study edition 2.0  |  Video, explanation, practice, proof
Contents
Why the calculation works
The formula refers to current inputs, so Excel can recalculate. In this simplified exercise, there
are no refunds, taxes or discounts. You must define these additional business rules before
applying the same revenue formula to a real report. Do not mistake the neat formula for a
complete revenue policy.
Try it yourself
Use the ready headers in A21:G21. Enter these inputs in A22:D26. Write Revenue, Profit and
Margin formulas in E22:G22 and fill down through row 26. Apply Percentage with two decimal
places to Margin.
Product
Quantity
Unit Price
Cost (whole row)
Pen
Book
Bag
Bottle
Folder
Check your work and recover
Recompute the Pen row manually: ten times twenty, then subtract 120, then divide profit by
revenue. Inspect E22 and E26 to ensure the filled formulas use their own row inputs. Change the
Bag price to 550 and check its dependent results, then restore 500. If Excel shows the formula as
literal text, remove a leading apostrophe and re-enter the formula in a General-formatted cell. If
a denominator is zero, division is undefined; investigate the business rule rather than replacing
the error with a misleading zero margin.
Review and changed retry
Save before opening EF5's answer. For a fresh retry, use a new row with Quantity 6, Unit Price 50
and total Cost 210. Create the three formulas without copying from the previous example and
explain what each reference represents.

EF6
SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX and
COUNT
Watch first
1. Chandoo - AVERAGE demonstration; the book teaches all five functions
Assigned range: 21:29-22:39. Stop manually at the end. AVERAGE demonstration; the book teaches all five
functions. Chapter-based assignment; complete playback has not been checked in this review.
Pause to connect the demonstration to the example below. Use the printed stop time when a bounded range is
given; longer recordings remain available for reference.
What you will do
Summarise a numeric range and verify which cells were included. The correct guided range in
the supplied workbook is B9:B16. Allow 75-105 minutes.
Words before we use them
Function
What it asks
SUM
What is the total of the numeric values?
AVERAGE
What is their arithmetic mean: total divided by numeric count?
MIN / MAX
What are the smallest and largest numeric values?
COUNT
How many cells in the range contain numbers?
Range
A group of cells. B9:B16 means B9 through B16, inclusive.
Follow with me once
On P-EF6_Functions, enter the following formulas beside the corresponding metric labels. Type
each formula yourself, then select it and inspect the first and last highlighted cells.
Cell
Formula
Expected result
E9
=SUM(B9:B16)
=AVERAGE(B9:B16)
=MIN(B9:B16)
=MAX(B9:B16)
=COUNT(B9:B16)
Check the total with two smaller groups: 1800 + 2400 + 900 + 5100 = 10200; 3200 + 2100 +
4100 + 3150 = 12550. Together they make 22750. Dividing by eight gives 2843.75. This manual

calculation is independent of the full-range SUM formula.
Why a correct-looking total can be wrong
Functions operate on the range you select. Selecting B9:B15 leaves out the last record. Including
a total row can count the same money twice. SUM, AVERAGE and COUNT ignore text cells in a
referenced range; a number accidentally stored as text can therefore disappear from your
calculation. COUNT does not check distinct order IDs.
Try it yourself
In A23:B30, create headers Day and Orders followed by Monday-Sunday and counts 12, 15, 0,
18, 10, 20, 16. Put your five formulas elsewhere, label them, and use B24:B30 as the range.
Verify the total by splitting the week into Monday-Wednesday and Thursday-Sunday.
Wednesday's zero is an observed count and must be included in the average.
Check your work and recover
Count the seven days and inspect both range endpoints. Temporarily replace Wednesday's 0
with an empty cell in your own copy. Observe that COUNT and AVERAGE change even though
SUM stays the same. Restore the zero. Missing and zero mean different things; a total alone
cannot distinguish them.
Review and changed retry
Save your attempt before opening EF6's answer. For the retry, change Sunday from 16 to 23 and
predict which results change before recalculating. Explain why COUNT stays the same while the
total and average change.

Relative and absolute cell references
Watch first
1. Chandoo - Cell references; spill references are optional at this stage
Assigned range: 12:35-20:52. Stop manually at the end. Cell references; spill references are optional at this stage.
Chapter-based assignment; complete playback has not been checked in this review.
2. Retained alternate: Excel formula references
Optional visual - no verified bounded range. Additional focused Chandoo explanation. Its title and topic were
corroborated from the video page; a bounded watch range has not been verified. Use the assigned segment above

Pause to connect the demonstration to the example below. Use the printed stop time when a bounded range is
given; longer recordings remain available for reference.
What you will do
Copy a calculation so each row uses its own price and the same shared rate. In this workbook,
the guided discount rate is H9, and the independent tax rate is H23. Allow 90-120 minutes.
Words before we use them
Reference
What happens when copied one row down
Becomes C13. The row can move.
Stays $H$9. Both column and row are fixed.
Row 9 stays fixed; the column can move if copied sideways.
Column H stays fixed; the row can move.
Picture it in your head
Each product carries its own price tag, but all five products use the discount displayed on one
shared sign. Moving to the next product changes the price tag you read. It should not move the
discount sign.
Follow with me once
1. On P-EF7_References, inspect H9 = 0.10. The five prices are in C12:C16. This exercise
calculates discount per unit; the Qty column is not used in this per-unit calculation.
2. In E12, enter =C12*$H$9. The discount is 100 on a price of 1000. In F12, enter =C12-E12 to
get a final unit price of 900.
3. Select E12:F16 with the first row's formulas at the top, then use Home > Fill > Down or Ctrl+D.
Inspect E13: it must read =C13*$H$9.

4. The discount amounts should be 100, 250, 80, 150, 60. The final unit prices should be 900,
5. Change H9 to 0.20. Every row's discount should change. Restore 0.10 before saving.
Why it worked and common mistakes
The price reference moves to the next row while the rate reference stays on H9. Without the
dollar signs, a copied formula may read an empty H10 and produce a misleading zero. Anchoring
C12 as $C$12 would make every row use the first product's price instead. Choose the anchor
from the meaning of the data.
Try it yourself
Use the existing six invoice rows A26:B31. The shared tax rate is already 0.18 in H23. In C26
calculate Tax from Amount and the fixed rate; in D26 calculate Final as Amount plus Tax. Fill
down through row 31. The 18% is a supplied arithmetic practice assumption, not a statement
about a real invoice's tax treatment.
Check your work and recover
Inspect the first, middle and final formulas. Each must refer to its own B-row and the same H23.
Manually calculate tax for I001 and I006. Temporarily change H23 to 0.10 and confirm every
invoice responds, then restore 0.18. If a result is suspicious, click the formula and trace both
references before changing any input.
Review and changed retry
Save before opening EF7's answer. For the retry, put a new shared rate of 0.05 in J5 and
calculate tax for amounts 400 and 900 in a clean area. Predict the second row's formula before
copying it.

EF8
Excel Tables
Watch first
1. Chandoo - Excel Tables
Assigned range: 02:22-12:35. Stop manually at the end. Excel Tables. Chapter-based assignment; complete
playback has not been checked in this review.
Pause to connect the demonstration to the example below. Use the printed stop time when a bounded range is
given; longer recordings remain available for reference.
What you will do
Recognise a real Excel Table, create one from a clean range, and add a record that becomes part
of that Table. A Table is an Excel object with a defined range and a name; colouring cells is only
formatting. Allow 75-105 minutes.
Words before we use them
Word
Meaning
Table
An Excel object that groups related records with headers and a name.
Table name
A workbook-level name such as DemoOrders or PracticeOrders.
Header row
The field names used by the Table.
Expansion
Extending the Table's range to include another record.
Follow with me once
1. On P-EF8_Tables, click A9 inside the upper block. Find Table Design and inspect Table Name: it
should be DemoOrders. On some Excel screens the tab is called Table.
2. Filter Region to East. D001 and D005 should remain visible. Clear the filter and confirm all five
records return.
3. In the blank row 14 immediately below the Table, enter D006, West, Ruler, 300 across
A14:D14. The Table should extend from A8:D13 to A8:D14.
4. Click D14 and confirm the Table tools are available. If automatic expansion did not happen,
use Table Design > Resize Table and explicitly select A8:D14. Do not include the instruction at
row 15.
Why it helps, and what it cannot guarantee
The Table keeps the data range together and provides consistent headers and filter controls. Its
name makes later formulas clearer. Expansion reduces the risk of overlooking new records.
However, Excel does not know whether D006 is a legitimate order or whether its amount is
correct. Duplicate IDs and incorrect values can still exist inside a Table.

Try it yourself
Select the lower input block A20:F28. Choose Insert > Table or press Ctrl+T, confirm "My table
has headers", and name it PracticeOrders. Add P009, 2026-08-05, East, Marker, 2, 400 in row 29.
Use a real date. Filter East, record the visible order IDs, clear the filter and inspect the Table's
final range.
Check your work and recover
The new order must belong to the Table, not sit just beneath it. Inspect the Table name and
range, count records after clearing the filter, and read P009 across. If Excel invents
Column1-style headers, undo and create the Table with the correct header row selected. If the
name already exists, check whether you already created the Table before creating a second one.
Review and changed retry
Save before opening EF8's answer. For a changed retry, create a separate three-record contact
list with Contact ID, Name and City and turn it into ContactsTable. Explain three benefits you
used and one check the Table does not perform for you.

EF9
Basic charts for clear comparison
Watch first
1. Chandoo - Chart demonstration
Assigned range: 22:39-27:26. Stop manually at the end. Chart demonstration. Chapter-based assignment; complete
playback has not been checked in this review.
Pause to connect the demonstration to the example below. Use the printed stop time when a bounded range is
given; longer recordings remain available for reference.
What you will do
Compare unordered regions with a column chart, then show time in chronological order with a
line chart. The workbook's independent task is the January-June monthly trend. Allow 90-120
minutes.
Words before we use them
Word
Meaning
Category
A group label, such as East or West.
Series
The set of numbers being plotted, here Revenue.
Axis
A scale or set of labels beside a chart.
Source range
The cells the chart reads.
Observation
